timepoint_policy.rule: Use the held-out/test-set evaluation explicitly reported by the source, not training performance.

primary_analysis_spec.outcome_group: Sensitivity of computer-aided diabetic retinopathy detection
selection_rules: Select one held-out image-level 2x2 diagnostic table per source.
Select only an expert-referenced DR-positive (NPDR/PDR) versus normal contrast with TP, FP, FN, and TN.
Use counts, not potentially mislabeled sensitivity/specificity columns or review forest values.
Select at most one eligible effect per independent study for this analysis.
